title_pt: Guardia Nacional e PROFEPA apreendem 345 animais no Baratillo
title_en: Guardia Nacional and PROFEPA seize 345 animals at Baratillo market
title_es: Guardia Nacional y PROFEPA decomisan 345 animales en el Baratillo
taxon_text: Trachemys venusta; Leptophis diplotropis; Iguana iguana; Brachypelma emilia; Eupsittula canicularis; outros táxons
card_text_pt: A Guardia Nacional encontrou 345 animais silvestres sendo comercializados ilegalmente no Tianguis del Baratillo; 66 foram posteriormente liberados e 34 morreram sob os efeitos das condições anteriores de manutenção.
card_text_en: The National Guard found 345 wild animals being illegally sold at the Baratillo market; 66 were later released and 34 died following the conditions in which they had been kept.
card_text_es: La Guardia Nacional halló 345 animales silvestres comercializados ilegalmente en el tianguis del Baratillo; 66 fueron liberados posteriormente y 34 murieron tras las condiciones previas de mantenimiento.

context_en: Documented facts: The National Guard found 345 wild animals being illegally sold at the Baratillo market; 66 were later released and 34 died following the conditions in which they had been kept. Analytical context: Taxonomic diversity and market sale show consolidation of different wildlife types but do not establish a single supply network. Evidence limits: No complete public group breakdown or origin/destination routes are available.
